label: Task-20
title: Add Vis.js graph visualization option
description:
Add Vis.js Network as an alternative graph visualization library.

## Why Vis.js?
- Purpose-built for network/graph visualization
- Excellent performance with large graphs
- Rich interaction model (clustering, physics, hierarchical layouts)
- Built-in clustering for complex graphs
- Timeline view option for temporal data

## Implementation
1. Add vis-network CDN to index.html
2. Create `graph-viewer-visjs.js` component
3. Map API response to Vis.js format:
   ```javascript
   const nodes = new vis.DataSet([
     { id: 'Feature-12', label: 'Feature-12', color: '#22c55e' },
     { id: 'Task-14', label: 'Task-14', color: '#3b82f6' }
   ]);
   const edges = new vis.DataSet([
     { from: 'Feature-12', to: 'Task-14', label: 'has-task' }
   ]);
   ```
4. Add layout options: hierarchical, physics-based, circular
5. Support node clustering for large graphs

## Pros
- Great performance
- Built-in clustering
- Multiple layout algorithms
- Good touch support

## Cons
- Larger bundle size
- Different styling approach than D3
